title: Common-refinement comparison on all bounded constructible inputs
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, C its coefficient datum, E/Q_C.l a finite extension, and n>=0. Let X,Y be finite-type quasi-compact schemes over D.k, and f:X->Y a separated finite-type quasi-compact morphism over D.k. Suppose every boundedConstructible object on X has a retained origin presentation. There is a natural isomorphism rho(c,d):inclusion⋙image(c)≅inclusion⋙image(d) for any compactifications c,d. For every common refinement b→c,b→d and every object K with any presentation (O,e), its component is theta(b→c,K,O,e).symm followed by theta(b→d,K,O,e). These natural isomorphisms satisfy rho(c,d)≫rho(d,b)=rho(c,b). This assertion concerns comparisons only and involves no projection map.

proof.text: Apply compactification_coherence on the witnessed category. Lift the inclusion of bounded constructible objects through its fully faithful fixed-object forgetful functor using the supplied origin presentations. Conjugate the comparison family by the resulting natural isomorphism. Fullness and naturality make this independent of every origin presentation, and the original cocycle gives the conjugated cocycle.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_cocycle
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[C.l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[C.l] E]
    (n : ℕ) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (origins : ∀ K : (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).FullSubcategory,
      ∃ O : RefinementFiniteLevelOrigin C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X,
        Nonempty (refinementFiniteLevelFixedObject C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X O ≅
          K.obj)) :
    ∃ rho : ∀ c d : Compactification f,
        (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).ι ⋙ image C.l E n c ≅
          (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).ι ⋙ image C.l E n d,
      (∀ (c d b : Compactification f) (r : b.Refinement c) (s : b.Refinement d)
        (K : (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).FullSubcategory)
        (O : RefinementFiniteLevelOrigin C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X)
        (e : refinementFiniteLevelFixedObject C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X O ≅ K.obj),
        (rho c d).app K = (theta C.l E n r K.obj O e).symm ≪≫
          theta C.l E n s K.obj O e) ∧
      (∀ c d b : Compactification f, rho c d ≪≫ rho d b = rho c b)
